summary: Frontend-only Playwright run (390x844 mobile viewport) on Expo web preview. Verified all 8 flows requested: onboarding, login + validation, custom bottom-tab navigation, home dashboard, FAB Add-Transaction sheet, Analytics, Goals (incl. new-goal modal), Profile (text-only identity card — confirmed NO images/avatar/camera UI), and Voice Assistant via long-press text fallback. Voice flow end-to-end works: 'add expense 750 for food' increased home-expense from ₹3,340 → ₹4,090 (+₹750 exactly) and voice-reply-bubble appeared; 'open analytics' navigated to the Analytics tab; 'what is my remaining budget' produced a reply bubble. Profile contains 0 tags and no avatar/camera/photo testIDs — image-removal requirement satisfied. Only one real UI bug found: the password TextInput placeholder renders the literal string `\u2022\u2022\u2022\u2022\u2022\u2022` instead of bullet dots because the JS source uses an escaped backslash sequence. Minor deprecation warnings logged from RN/Reanimated (non-blocking).

ui_bugs.issue: Placeholder shows literal text \u2022\u2022\u2022\u2022\u2022\u2022 instead of bullet chars. In /app/frontend/app/login.tsx line 79 the value is the string '\u2022...' (backslash is literal). Use actual bullet characters "••••••" or '\u2022' as an unescaped unicode escape inside a normal JS string (not the literal two-char escape). Suggested fix: placeholder={'\u2022'.repeat(6)} or placeholder="••••••".

issues: Reply bubble overlays Categories grid (positioned at bottom + 70 from FAB). When category amounts have non-zero values, the bubble sits over them briefly. Consider rendering bubble above the FAB but inside the safe-bottom area, not over content.

react_native_issues.issue: Console warns repeatedly: '"shadow*" style props are deprecated. Use "boxShadow".' and 'props.pointerEvents is deprecated. Use style.pointerEvents'. Originates from src/theme (shadow.card / shadow.soft) and Pressable usage. Reference: /app/frontend/src/theme/index.ts (shadow tokens).

Console warns: 'TouchableMixin is deprecated. Please use Pressable.' and emits multiple 'Unknown event handler property onStartShouldSetResponder / onResponderGrant / onPressOut' errors after navigating. Likely from a TouchableOpacity inside one of the screens (Analytics/Goals modals). Migrate remaining TouchableMixin-based components to Pressable.
'Invalid DOM property transform-origin. Did you mean transformOrigin?' — likely from an inline style or a chart library. Investigate Analytics charts (BudgetRing / pie / bar).

action_items: Fix login password placeholder so bullet characters render (login.tsx line 79).
Migrate shadow.* tokens to boxShadow (or guard for web) to silence deprecation warnings.
Replace remaining TouchableMixin/TouchableOpacity usages with Pressable to remove deprecation warnings.
Fix invalid transform-origin DOM property (use transformOrigin) in chart/ring components.
Optional: reposition voice-reply-bubble so it doesn't overlap the categories grid on Home.
critical_code_review_comments: AsyncStorage-only persistence is fine for this MVP; no backend changes needed.
VoiceAssistant.tsx correctly opens text fallback on long-press in web preview where STT is unreliable (verified).
Profile screen uses gradient + Text only — fully compliant with the 'no images' requirement.
seed_data_creation: None. Store already seeds sample transactions/goals on first launch (observed ₹39,500 income, ₹3,340 expense, 4 goals).
context_for_next_testing_agent: Use viewport 390x844, clear localStorage before testing to reset onboarding. Long-press voice-assistant-fab to open voice-fallback-input (web Chromium has no SpeechRecognition). All requested testIDs are present and functional. The store seeds demo data on first launch — expect non-zero balances even for a brand-new user.
rca_of_issue: Password placeholder shows escaped chars because the source string is double-escaped: `placeholder="\u2022\u2022..."` evaluates to a literal backslash-u sequence rather than the bullet code point. Fix by using a real bullet character or a single-escape inside a JS string literal.
